independenceStatement: Expected per-link {status, unlinked} derived ONLY from anchor-regression.json's known construction + the built resolver ladder (linkStatusResolverQueries.ts): unlinked_at -> broken; missing anchor/page/geometry -> broken; geometry_captured_at mismatch -> needs_review; document superseded (another doc's supersedesDocumentId == it) -> needs_review; else valid. INDEPENDENT of harness output (A07-GATE-00 §3 applied to A3). docOld is superseded by docNew. aStale's geometryCapturedAt t0 != current t1. docA/7 has no page; docC/0 has a page but no geometry. L7 unlinks the otherwise-valid aValid (broken+unlinked); L8 is the relinked counterpart (unlinkedAt cleared -> valid).
